# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/ionosctl
# args: 
IonosCTL is a command-line interface for the IONOS CLOUD API.


FLAGS:
  -u, --api-url string    Override default host url (default "https://api.ionos.com")
  -c, --config string     Configuration file used for authentication (default "/home/ubuntu/.config/ionosctl/config.yaml")
  -D, --depth int         Level of detail for response objects (default 1)
  -F, --filters strings   Limit results to results containing the specified filter:KEY1=VALUE1,KEY2=VALUE2
  -f, --force             Force command to execute without user input
  -h, --help              Print usage
      --limit int         Maximum number of items to return per request (default 50)
      --no-headers        Don't print table headers when table output is used
      --offset int        Number of items to skip before starting to collect the results
      --order-by string   Property to order the results by
  -o, --output string     Desired output format [text|json|api-json] (default "text")
      --query string      JMESPath query string to filter the output
  -q, --quiet             Quiet output
  -t, --timeout int       Timeout in seconds for --wait and other wait operations (default 600)
  -v, --verbose count     Increase verbosity level [-v, -vv, -vvv]
      --version           version for ionosctl
  -w, --wait              Wait for the resource to reach AVAILABLE state after the command completes. No-op for list commands

USAGE:
  ionosctl [flags]


Cloud Services:
  cdn                     Manage CDN distributions
  certmanager             Manage SSL certificates
  compute                 Manage servers, volumes, networking, K8s, load balancers, and more
  container-registry      Manage container registries
  dbaas                   Manage database clusters
  dns                     Manage DNS zones and records
  kafka                   Manage Kafka clusters and topics
  logging-service         Manage logging pipelines
  monitoring              Manage monitoring pipelines
  object-storage          Object Storage operations for contract-owned buckets
  vm-autoscaling          Manage VM autoscaling groups and policies
  vpn                     Manage VPN gateways

Authentication & Configuration:
  config                  Manage CLI configuration
  login                   Authenticate and generate a config file
  token                   Manage authentication tokens

Other:
  completion              Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help                    Help about any command
  man                     Generate manpages
  shell                   Start an interactive shell
  version                 Show the version

Use "ionosctl [command] --help" for more information about a command.
